name: Daring Lime's: Smooth as Silk
description_md:
Playstyle: Tempo
Player Count: 1-2 players
Power: Beyond Omega Level
Difficulty To Pilot: Extreme
--- Silk is a brand new addition to the ***WEB-WARRIOR*** roster. I played her enough to figure out a great deck build for her that is thematic and highlights her strength. So I wanted to share it with all of you so that your games can be *Smooth as Silk* too! Get ready to [Swinging Silk Kick](/card/52003) your way to victory along with the help of your ***WEB-WARRIOR*** friends! --- --- ### ***Smooth Sailing*** For Silk's kit to run smoothly, she needs to have a constant stream of cards tucking under her identity. In the mid to late game, this isn't an issue, especially with the help of [Spider Reflexes](/card/52012). But in the early game, it can be difficult to set up your upgrades, deal with the board state, and get tucked cards. This deck solves that problem with [One Way or Another](/card/22015) and [Face the Past](/card/49022). These cards feel tailor made to Silk! Not only do they give you massive card draw, allowing you to set up your board, they also let you tuck the side scheme or minion after you defeat it! Making it even more valuable than normal. Combine that with [Skilled Investigator](/card/04047) and [Clear the Area](/card/04049) and you're off to the races! --- ### ***A Silky Smooth Finish*** After speed running your early game, and controlling the board with your allies and upgrades, you'll be ready to take out the villain in a most glorious fashion! Make sure to start storing the villain's cards under Silk as you prepare for the final push. You'll need them to get max value out of your cards. There are 3 key cards to be aware of. 1. [Swinging Silk Kick](/card/52003) - 9 Damage with overkill when you discard a card from the villain's encounter set. 2. [Spider Claws](/card/52011) - 6 basic ATK with piercing if you can manage all four cards to be of the right kind (2-3 cards will do just fine though). 3. [Ghost-Spider](/card/27048) - Searches your [Swinging Silk Kick](/card/52003) and draws you a card from [Web of Life and Destiny](/card/30023). With these three cards combined you'll easily play 2-3 [Swinging Silk Kick](/card/52003)s in one turn and have a strong basic attack with piercing. This is enough to take out a whole stage of the villain no problem. Especially when you factor in your other allies and readies that you have available. --- This link will take you to an updated list that is built purely to achieve maximum power. I'll update this as the card pool expands. https://marvelcdb.com/deck/view/947216 --- ### ***Other Card Considerations*** - [Moon Girl](/card/28018) - She is extremely powerful. Switching [Spider-Woman](/card/27041) for [Moon Girl](/card/28018) would make the deck more powerful. This deck just already crushes the villains, so the extra power isn't necessary and I wanted some variety so I didn't include it. - [Otto Octavius](/card/31022) - In hindsight I wish I had included this card. I like his ability to ready up [Ingenuity](/card/29027) and Silk's upgrades. --- I hope you enjoy playing Silk as much as I have! This deck is a blast to play. Keep your eye out for a review and guide for Silk on my channel. I've been having so much fun with her that I plan on making plenty of informative videos to share with you all.
